insights.summary: First investor presentation after the 26 May 2026 listing on NSE Emerge (no call held). Teamtech, a Hyderabad maker of modular steel T-formwork that it sells, rents and refurbishes for infrastructure projects (bullet train, Delhi-Mumbai Expressway, Subansiri dam), reported FY26 revenue of ₹54 Cr (+66%), EBITDA ₹17.5 Cr (32%) and PAT ₹11.6 Cr. The deck projects FY27 revenue of ₹94.6 Cr (EBITDA ₹27.9 Cr, PAT ₹20 Cr) and FY28 of ₹140 Cr (EBITDA ₹42 Cr), with H1 FY27 alone expected to match FY26 after a ₹18 Cr Q1. A new 44,000 sq ft unit roughly triples capacity; the company is debt-free after its IPO.

what_changed.text: FY27 projection: revenue ₹94.6 Cr, EBITDA ₹27.9 Cr, PAT ₹20 Cr
FY28 projection: revenue ₹140 Cr, EBITDA ₹42 Cr, PAT ₹29.4 Cr
H1 FY27 revenue to match FY26's ₹54 Cr

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Strategic capacity expansion to ~3x current scale, positioning TeamTech for accelerated growth.

red_flags.text: Projections come from a chart with no call or explanation of assumptions.
FY26 operating cash flow was only ₹3 Cr on ₹12 Cr of profit; debtor days were 204 (Screener).
FY26 annual report: ₹13.5 Cr of sales (about a quarter of revenue) to a related party, apparently Teamtech Formwork Solutions FZC (UAE), in which all three directors are interested.

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Modular steel T-formwork and custom formwork systems for vertical concrete (piers, walls, shafts, tanks), sold, rented and refurbished; in-house design software
business_snapshot.customers: Infrastructure EPC contractors (L&T, Tata Projects, Shapoorji Pallonji, Patel Engineering, Cemindia and others) in India and the UAE
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Sales, rental and refurbishment; exports ~6% of FY27 revenue expected
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Highways, rail, metro, bridges, dams and high-rise construction; shift from timber to modular formwork
